notes: C10: display names and one short story line for the A6 decorations (PR #122, incoming-art/decor-pool-a6/). Fields follow content/dojo/decorations.json (id, name, description). Only the 6 entries under 'samples' have real ids from PR #122's sprites/static.json. Entries under 'tier1Kinds' and 'classPieces' use PROPOSED ids (marked proposed: true) because PR #122 has no art or ids for them yet; the Programmer or Artist can swap in final ids. Decorations are looks only and give no power. Names avoid existing decoration names (Stone Lantern, Bonsai Tree, Dojo Banner, Calligraphy Scroll, etc.) and approved names (Glowing Scroll Shelf, Dojo Trim).
